source_quotes: we don't auto sync with p2p we notify and allow others to act via gate
overlap_check: Extends draft 09 with the paired-device versus marketplace distinction and the jurisdiction additions to serving and publishing. Add-only.

add_heuristics.condition: a doctrine says a sync path gets no action
add_heuristics.action: check whether it covers paired devices only before applying it to the marketplace

add_decision_rules.name: Paired devices are not the marketplace
add_decision_rules.condition: a doctrine says sync gets no action
add_decision_rules.outcome: apply it to paired-device sync only; the peer marketplace keeps getting full work, and 'paired' in marketplace code means the operator-approved peer allow-list

add_decision_rules.name: Serving scans the body
add_decision_rules.outcome: scan it for personal-data shapes and hold it until the operator approves that content hash

add_decision_rules.name: Publish kinds are policy
add_decision_rules.condition: an item is announced, listed or served
add_decision_rules.outcome: allow only the kinds the instance's policy lists; a jurisdiction policy may be offered, a receiver only stages it, and adoption is the receiver's explicit call

add_decision_rules.name: Say what cannot be recalled
add_decision_rules.outcome: tell them in the interface that published items cannot be recalled
